relationships.subject: BPCP
relationships.evidence_quote: BPCP demonstrated superior suppressive efficacy, reducing the levels of major cytokines (IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-6, IL-8) by half as compared to sPRP

relationships.subject: platelet-rich plasma
relationships.evidence_quote: sPRP demonstrated superior neuroprotective potential by strongly upregulating CSF1 and partially rescuing SLC12A5 expression

relationships.subject: platelet-rich plasma
relationships.evidence_quote: sPRP displayed a distinct pro-resolving and neuroprotective trend, upregulating IL-10 and TGF-β1

key_findings: BPCP suppressed IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-8 about twofold more than standard PRP in an iPSC sensory neuron-microglia co-culture
Standard PRP favoured resolution (IL-10, TGF-beta1 up) and partially rescued SLC12A5 (KCC2) expression
